title: Rav Tachlifa, Brother of Ravinai of Chozai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Beitzah 16b: he recited a baraita: “All of a person’s food is allotted to him from Rosh Hashanah,” etc.; Rabbi Abbahu said, “What is the verse?” etc. Hyman infers that he preceded Rabbi Abbahu. The Rif and the Rosh have a different reading.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied locator is Beitzah 16b. In the William Davidson digital text the reciter’s name is at the end of 15b and the baraita begins at 16a; 16b instead has Rav Tachlifa bar Avdimi. מר״ה means “from Rosh Hashanah.” Hyman’s chronological inference is retained, and the historical locator is not erased.

The checked Beitzah text names the reciter as Tachlifa, brother of Rabnai of Chozai, at 15b, followed by the provisions baraita and Abbahu’s verse discussion at 16a. The supplied Ravinai form and 16b pointer remain unchanged; the separate Tachlifa bar Avdimi at 16b is not merged with him. Hyman’s chronological inference and his Rif and Rosh variant report remain attributed; those two printed witnesses were not separately collated.
